metaDescription: Explore Penn KDSAP’s community health education activities and kidney awareness resources.
title: Kidney health learning designed for community settings
summary: Penn KDSAP volunteers and physicians share general educational materials through presentations, screening stations, and community workshops.
heroImageAlt: A Penn KDSAP volunteer leading a training discussion
sectionText: These examples describe chapter activities and do not provide medical advice or replace care from a qualified clinician.

initiatives.title: CKD education
initiatives.text: Volunteers share general information about chronic kidney disease during community events and screening activities.

initiatives.title: Nutrition education
initiatives.text: Partner-led demonstrations and materials help make health education practical and approachable.

initiatives.title: Student outreach
initiatives.text: Interactive workshops introduce younger students to kidney anatomy, physiology, and health careers.

disclaimer: For personal medical questions, speak with a licensed health professional. For an emergency, call 911.
